import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
load=lambda p: json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
a=load('audit.json'); m=load('manifest.json'); fields=load('fields.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==a['inputSha256']
def at(obj,p):
 for k in p.split('/')[1:]:
  k=k.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')
  obj=obj[int(k)] if isinstance(obj,list) else obj[k]
 return obj
assert a['reviewedPointers']==[f['pointer'] for f in fields]
assert len(set(a['reviewedPointers']))==len(fields)
inputs={k:load(v) for k,v in [('source','source.json'),('probe','probe-results.json'),('verification','verification.json')]}
findings={f['id']:f for f in a['findings']}
assert len(findings)==len(a['findings'])
for f in a['findings']:
 assert any(e['file'] in ('source','probe') for e in f['evidence'])
 for e in f['evidence']:
  v=at(inputs[e['file']],e['pointer'])
  assert e['quote'] in v if 'quote' in e else e['value']==v
seen=set(); linked=set()
import re
for e in a['edits']:
 assert e['pointer'] in a['reviewedPointers'] and e['pointer'] not in seen
 seen.add(e['pointer'])
 for id in e['findingIds']:
  assert findings[id]['pointer']==e['pointer']; linked.add(id)
 assert re.findall(r'\{\{(?:CODE|DIAGRAM):\d+\}\}',at(m,e['pointer']))==re.findall(r'\{\{(?:CODE|DIAGRAM):\d+\}\}',e['value'])
assert linked==set(findings)
print('Verified hash, field coverage, evidence references, edit links, and placeholder preservation.')
